title: Unsloth - Qwen3 & Dynamic 2.0
body_markdown:
# Unsloth - Qwen3 & Dynamic 2.0


### Introducing Dynamic 2.0 quants and Qwen3.


[Unsloth AI](https://substack.com/@unsloth)


May 02, 2025


We’re excited to introduce


[Unsloth Dynamic 2.0](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/unsloth-dynamic-2.0-ggufs) which outperforms leading quantization methods and sets new benchmarks for 5-shot MMLU and KL Divergence. This means you can now run + fine-tune quantized LLMs with minimal accuracy loss!


The new Qwen3 models deliver advancements in reasoning, instruction-following and multilingual support.


You can fine-tune Qwen3 up to


**8x longer context lengths** with Unsloth compared to all setups with FA2 on a 24GB GPU. Qwen3-30B-A3B comfortably fits on 17.5GB VRAM. We released a Colab notebook for


[Qwen3 (14B) here](https://colab.research.google.com/github/unslothai/notebooks/blob/main/nb/Qwen3_(14B)-Reasoning-Conversational.ipynb) .


We uploaded Qwen3 GGUFs using our Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 method and also uploaded Qwen3 with native 128K context windows (up from 40K).


[Read Qwen3 Blog](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/qwen3-how-to-run-and-fine-tune)


### Other Highlights:


-


Meta released Llama 4 in Scout and Maverick variants. You can run them locally with our Dynamic 2.0 GGUFs.


-


We collaborated with Meta on a


[Synthetic Datasets notebook](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7323725798346010625) .


-


Microsoft released their new reasoning models for Phi-4 which you can now run or fine-tune with Unsloth.
